reviewed_claim: Official HNX Notice 1385/TB-SGDHN dated 2018-11-21 states that GDW's UPCoM registration cancellation is effective 2018-12-07 and that 2018-12-06 is its last trading day at HNX. Official HNX Notice 1458/TB-SGDHN dated 2018-12-06 states that the first HNX trading date is 2018-12-18. These records establish the venue endpoints only; no day-level trading, suspension, or delisting state is inferred for the intervening sessions. HNX's separate 2018-12-06 daily report records zero matched volume despite the official final-session date.
